market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely volatile with oil-driven inflation as primary swing factor. S&P 500 supported by Fed dovish tilt and AI earnings but capped by $97 oil and JPY intervention risk. Expect 3-5% range-bound trading with upside limited until Iran situation stabilizes. Dell/Nvidia momentum may drive tech leadership. Watch for any Fed speaker reversing dovish tone.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict resolves within 60-90 days, oil normalizes and rate-hike fears fade, supporting a 10-15% equity rally. AI capex cycle (Dell, TSM, Nvidia) provides structural growth through 2027. Refining crunch keeps energy premium but supports transition investment. K-shaped consumer split persists; value/essentials outperform premium. Autonomous vehicle inflection (Tesla Cybercab) could create new sector leadership by Q1 2027.
